output.reason: Two weeks postpartum with detachment, constant crying and new frightening thoughts of harming the baby requires immediate in-person emergency psychiatric assessment to distinguish postpartum depression with intrusive thoughts from postpartum psychosis and ensure infant safety today.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now for an urgent mental health assessment, and have someone else care for and stay with your baby until you are seen. New thoughts of harming your baby two weeks after birth need same-hour, in-person evaluation. Ask someone to drive you or call 911 if you feel unsafe or unable to get there. You are not in trouble for telling us this.
